title: General Circuit Element
text: Model two-port network described by rfckt object, {Plot type} sets Type of data plot X-Y; {RFCKT object}, {Source of frequency data} sets the frequency data source, {Frequency data (Hz)} sets the frequency data range, {Reference impedance (ohms)}, {Y parameter1} sets the type of parameters, {Y parameter2} sets the type of parameters, {Y format1} plots format Magnitude, {Y format2} plots format Magnitude, {X parameter} sets the frequency plot, {X format} sets the frequency plot format, {Y scale} sets the y-axis scale, {X scale} sets the x-axis scale and {Plot}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: RFCKT object
params.values: RFCKT object that contains circuit element device data read(rfckt.passive, ’passive.s2p’) (default) | any rfckt object

params.name: Plot type
params.values: Type of data plot X-Y plane (default) | Composite data | Polar plane | Z Smith chart | Y Smith chart | ZY Smith chart

params.name: Y parameter1
params.values: Type of parameters to plot S11 (default) | S12 | S21 | S22 | GroupDelay | OIP3 | IIP3 | NF |...

params.name: Y parameter2
params.values: Type of parameters to plot S11 (default) | S12 | S21 | S22 | GroupDelay | OIP3 | IIP3 | NF |...

params.name: Y format1
params.values: Plot format Magnitude (decibels) (default) | Mag | Magnitude (linear) | Angle | Real | Imaginary |...

params.name: Y format2
params.values: Plot format Magnitude (decibels) (default) | Mag | Magnitude (linear) | Angle | Real | Imaginary |...

params.name: X format
params.values: Frequency plot format Hz (default) | Auto | kHz | MHz | GHz | THz
